title: War of 1812
summary: A war between the United States and Great Britain over British violations of U.S. maritime rights, set against the Napoleonic conflict and frontier tensions with Native Americans. Fighting centred on the Great Lakes region. The Treaty of Ghent brought peace without major concessions, but British withdrawal and Creek defeat opened the way for U.S. expansion.

as_recorded.value: Congress declared war against Great Britain on 18 June 1812

where.modern_name: Great Lakes region, United States and Canada (proxy pin: Lake Erie; fighting centred on the Great Lakes)
where.historical_name: Upper Canada and the Northwest Territory

importance.justification: Shaped U.S.-British-Canadian relations and North American expansion, though regional in scope.
